message.content: The SEC 10-K confirms Apple's own figures — the "corrected" site is unreliable and I'm discarding it. Let me check the account and one more news angle.
message.reasoning:
The SEC filing confirms $391,035M net sales, $93,736M net income, $6.08 diluted EPS, operating income $123,216M. The fin-data-live.net claim is false — a low-quality site contradicting both Apple's newsroom and SEC EDGAR. I'll discard it.

Let me check the account and maybe one more news source on recent developments (Apple Intelligence, iPhone 16 demand). Let me check account.
